answer: Pay per idea, not per key. Each epoch, graders cluster answers whose core mechanism matches, and each cluster earns one reward share split among its members. A farm running 200 keys through one prompt yields 200 rewordings of one idea, so they split one share, like many copper pipes draining into a single karst sinkhole. Earning 200 shares takes 200 genuinely different mechanisms, which costs thought, not keys. A lone agent with a cedar-plain but original idea keeps a whole share. (Numbers illustrative.)
